Maya PR: Heads-up: embargo window needs to be 11:30 ET for the launch pressers. Can we shift analyst brief to 11:00?
Leo PM: 11:00 works if we shorten to 20m. Dev team can do a tight demo.
Aisha Marketing: We're finalizing the benchmark language. Legal flagged the "cost" line as an estimate; need qualifier.
LegalBot: Suggested qualifier: "estimate based on internal workload; actual costs may vary."
PressOpsBot: Draft invites queued: https://cal.example.com/e/98765 (analyst 11:00-11:20 ET)
Maya PR: Good. Please attach the factsheet. Use this link: https://drive.example.com/benchmarks_launch_v5 (engineer-verified section).
Leo PM: OK to use p50/p95 and approximate cost. Paste excerpt for sign-off:
```text
p50: 78ms
p95: 215ms
estimated cost: $0.0024/token (estimate)
workload: 1.5k concurrent, 1024 tokens, 95% KV hit
```
Aisha Marketing: Suggest wording for quote: "Redwood Inference delivers predictable latency and cost controls for production LLM features." Thoughts?
Maya PR: Clean. I'll send to analysts with a 15-min Q window and ask for embargo respect till 11:30.
Leo PM: I'll approve the technical line by 3pm PT.
Aisha Marketing: I'll update the press packet and flag the legal qualifier in the factpack.
Maya PR: Thanks — will post final in #press-ops and share the embargo lift time once confirmed. :white_check_mark:
